ideas.pitch: An AI-powered OSCE exam simulator and CPR posture trainer built for medical and nursing students.
ideas.title: Clinical-Simulator for Campus Healthcare
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly replicates a proven Grand Prize winning pattern (Cornell AI Hackathon) combining interactive LLM personas with MediaPipe computer vision pose tracking for objective clinical grading.

ideas.pitch: A real-time computer vision platform analyzing cricket batting shots using pose estimation and confidence gating to prevent injury.
ideas.title: CricketVision Biomechanics Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors a first-prize winner (NeuroForge Hackathon) by tackling a highly specific sports-science domain with rigorous metrics instead of generic wrappers.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous data engineering agent that detects pipeline anomalies, runs root-cause analysis, and automatically writes back fixes to metadata catalogs.
ideas.title: DataHub Autonomous Incident Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the winning formula of the DataHub Agent Hackathon by solving a high-friction enterprise infrastructure problem with automated remediation.

ideas.pitch: An AWS-powered anti-money laundering transaction graph intelligence platform using LightGBM and explainable feature attributions.
ideas.title: AML Risk Intelligence Graph
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies the exact architecture of a 1st-place fintech hackathon winner, targeting judges with a heavy emphasis on regulatory risk detection and graph analytics.

ideas.pitch: An agentic disaster response coordinator that aggregates crowdsourced SOS signals and prioritizes resource dispatch using multi-agent workflows.
ideas.title: CrisisSync Disaster Mesh
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs the proven multi-agent coordination pattern that won the AI Agents Hackathon, appealing heavily to social impact and systems-heavy judging criteria.
